narrative.intro: Salus Worldwide Solutions recorded $518M in contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Salus Worldwide Solutions secured 2 awards so far, with an average award size of $259M. Salus Worldwide Solutions obligations are up 178.3% year over year compared with the prior fiscal period. Salus Worldwide Solutions had no recorded obligations in FY21 through FY24, then recorded $186M in FY25 before the FY26 to date total. Salus Worldwide Solutions is concentrated in air-transportation related work: Nonscheduled Chartered Passenger Air Transportation accounts for $512M and Other Support Activities for Air Transportation accounts for $5.7M. The current-year totals are partial because the period is fiscal year to date, and the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables report total contract values rather than obligations.
